name: @itslil/posthog-js
description: PostHog 1.435.8 utility ports and an experimental complete browser SDK integration, compiled through LilScript.
author: yeargun

scripts.build: npm run build:utilities && npm run build:sdk && npm run measure:utilities && npm run measure:tree-shaking && npm run package:sdk
scripts.test:packs: npm run build:packs:dev && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/surveys.compat.test.mjs test/error-tracking.compat.test.mjs test/otlp.compat.test.mjs test/autocapture.compat.test.mjs test/replay-core.compat.test.mjs
scripts.test:packs:raw: POSTHOGLIL_SURVEYS_ARTIFACT=dist/surveys.raw.js POSTHOGLIL_ERROR_TRACKING_ARTIFACT=dist/error-tracking.raw.js POSTHOGLIL_OTLP_ARTIFACT=dist/otlp.raw.js POSTHOGLIL_AUTOCAPTURE_ARTIFACT=dist/autocapture.raw.js POSTHOGLIL_REPLAY_CORE_ARTIFACT=dist/replay-core.raw.js node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/surveys.compat.test.mjs test/error-tracking.compat.test.mjs test/otlp.compat.test.mjs test/autocapture.compat.test.mjs test/replay-core.compat.test.mjs
scripts.test:packs:release: POSTHOGLIL_SURVEYS_ARTIFACT=dist/surveys.esm.js POSTHOGLIL_ERROR_TRACKING_ARTIFACT=dist/error-tracking.esm.js POSTHOGLIL_OTLP_ARTIFACT=dist/otlp.esm.js POSTHOGLIL_AUTOCAPTURE_ARTIFACT=dist/autocapture.esm.js POSTHOGLIL_REPLAY_CORE_ARTIFACT=dist/replay-core.esm.js node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/surveys.compat.test.mjs test/error-tracking.compat.test.mjs test/otlp.compat.test.mjs test/autocapture.compat.test.mjs test/replay-core.compat.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:utilities && npm run test:tree-shaking && npm run test:upstream && npm run test:sdk-browser && npm run package:sdk && npm run test:sdk-package
scripts.check:site: npm run build:site && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/site.test.mjs && node test/site-browser.mjs
scripts.build:sdk: node scripts/plan-sdk.mjs && node scripts/build-sdk-internals.mjs --combined && node scripts/build-sdk-internals.mjs --surface=standard && node scripts/build-sdk-internals.mjs --surface=full && node scripts/build-sdk.mjs
scripts.test:utilities: npm test && npm run test:packs:release && npm run test:packs:package
